title: Evaluation brief drops gate obligation assessments and reports "current control authority requires recovery", so a passing gate evaluates 0/N insufficient
outcome: An acceptance evaluation whose cited gate and live verification records carry matching obligation assessments receives those assessments and the canonical criterion-evidence index in its brief (or an explicit, actionable recovery path), instead of an insufficient-evidence verdict caused by host-side brief surfacing.
acceptance: Evaluation brief drops gate obligation assessments and reports "current control authority requires recovery", so a passing gate evaluates 0/N insufficient is done
